If you want, I can now also implement a minimal `ReviewRepository` skeleton in the same data layer so the next wave can start wiring review flow without waiting on multiple follow-up blockers.

--- Claude (lane the primary UI — the main screens the user sees and taps through, plus navigation and layout) ---
Good, everything's in place and self-contained. Wrapping up this iteration.

`ModelContainerFactory` landed for real (Codex A), and it correctly uses my `RecallDataError` stub's exact shape (`.containerUnavailable(underlying:)`) — that confirms the stub did its job and there's no drift to reconcile. That should clear the last build-verification blocker from iteration 2, though repositories still don't exist so persistence itself isn't reachable yet.

Given that, I built the pieces that were purely mine to build and had zero dependency risk: `DeckListViewState` + `DeckCellVM` (the frozen contract I own, with construction routed through smart static factories so the "loose booleans forming impossible states" failure mode literally can't happen — no way to build `isLoading: true` with a populated `decks` array, etc.), `DeckListView` rendering all five states (loading/error/empty/all-caught-up/populated) reusing Codex B's `EmptyStateView`/`LoadingStateView`/`ErrorStateView`, and `DeckEditorView`/`CardEditorView` — real keyboard-first forms with async/throws save actions that preserve typed input and re-enable the button on failure rather than wiping the form, per the "no fake success" rule. Also built `DemoDataTag`, the locked do-not-regress component nobody had started yet, since `DeckListView`'s rows need it and it directly satisfies flow token `demoData.tag`.

None of this is wired into live navigation yet — `StudyRootView` is untouched, still showing the honest "not yet available" placeholder — because there's still no `DeckRepository`/`CardRepository` to feed real data through, and I'm not going to fake decks or ship a Save button with nowhere real to save to. But `study.addDeckButton`, `study.deckCell_0`, `deckEditor.nameField`, `deckEditor.saveButton`, `cardEditor.frontField`, `cardEditor.backField`, `cardEditor.saveButton` are all now sitting in fully-built, correct components — the moment repositories land, wiring `StudyRootView` up is a small job, not another multi-iteration slog.

Left for next round: `deckDetail.studyButton`, `deckDetail.addCardButton`, `review.revealButton`, `review.gradeGood` still need Deck Detail + Review Session, which need `SM2Engine` (still doesn't exist in `RecallScheduling` — that's the project's explicit #1 priority and it's now been three waves) plus `ReviewSessionService`/`ReviewRepository`. That's squarely data_domain/services_utilities territory, not something I can front-run the way I did with the view layer here.
